# VinaX

> Free music-streaming web app and Android app. Sign in once with a Google account; there is no subscription and nothing to pay. Recommendations are worked out on your device. Play songs, albums and playlists with synced lyrics, a queue that builds itself from the song you tap, shared listening sessions, endless Radio, and offline downloads in the Android app. Tuned for regional and Indian music: Telugu, Hindi, Tamil and more.

## Pages

- [Home](https://www.vinaxmusic.online/): Personalized music home, arranged on your device
- [Search](https://www.vinaxmusic.online/search): Search songs, albums, artists and playlists
- [Charts](https://www.vinaxmusic.online/charts): Trending charts
- [Movies](https://www.vinaxmusic.online/movies): Film soundtracks
- [Moods](https://www.vinaxmusic.online/moods): Music by mood
- [For You This Week](https://www.vinaxmusic.online/weekly): A personalized weekly mix
- [Radio](https://www.vinaxmusic.online/radio): Endless music from a song, an artist, a mood or a station
- [About](https://www.vinaxmusic.online/about): What VinaX is and who makes it
- [Help](https://www.vinaxmusic.online/help): Step-by-step guides, answers to common questions, keyboard shortcuts and gestures

## What a listener can do

- Tap any song and VinaX lines up the next five, led by that song's language; songs queued by hand play first.
- Choose how adventurous the queue is: Familiar, Balanced or Discover.
- Search by title, artist, album or a line of lyrics.
- Change the whole look in Settings → Appearance → App style: Aura, Pulse, Sangam, Nocturne, Marquee or Vibe. Theme (Dark, Black, Light, System, Auto) and accent colour are separate choices.
- On festival days the app takes that festival's colours and shows a greeting once; Settings → Appearance can preview any festival or switch festival themes off.
- Listen Together: start a session and share a link, a QR code or a room code.
- Back up the library and settings to one file, restore it, or move to a new device with a one-time code.

## Notes

- VinaX is free: no subscription and no premium tier.
- A Google account is required to use VinaX (one tap). The Privacy, Terms and Contact pages are readable without signing in.
- Favourites, playlists, history and the taste profile are kept on the listener's device.
- Audio is sourced from public music APIs and is not hosted by VinaX.
- Canonical origin is https://www.vinaxmusic.online (with www).
